correctness.rationale: The forest-face dichotomy is exact: three occupied parts force a triangle, and two parts each occupied twice force a 4-cycle; all remaining two-part configurations are stars. With B the disjoint union of part simplices, every relative simplex has a unique two-part support, giving an integral chain splitting. Mayer–Vietoris for (Δ(V_i)*D_j)∪(D_i*Δ(V_j)) gives H_2=W_i⊗W_j, and the pair LES and incidence map of K_k give H_1(K_k). The two signs under shore exchange cancel, so the full integral action and traces follow. Covers singleton parts and k=2; finite verify.py code was inspected but its samples are not the infinite proof.
